title: The code pipeline's inspectors and gates live inside CodeMother
owner: codemother owns the components once moved; CC builds the move (CC stays co-listed in each gated_by until her hand, line up and judgment exist, ruling 2026-09-06)
intention: Everything whose only purpose is the code design/build pipeline lives inside CodeMother and is owned by her, so the builders pass gates they do not hold: plan_inspector, diagnostic_inspector, corrosion, exemptions, rehearsal and build_inspector move from cairn/machines/ to cairn/devices/codemother/machines/.
why: Akien 2026-10-27, answers to Q#31 (open-000da50a5fb6) and open-a2525ca4d225: 'build inspector did used to be a stand alone thing. it should wind up inside code mother now that that is no longer true. why did we make the change? because we wanted to set up a POTENTIALLY ADVERSARIAL RELATIONSHIP between builders and CodeMother.' / 'everything that has no purpose other than helping our design and build pipeline for code belongs to code mother.' The measured symptom: c66b25d122e6 D9, where RULE 1 redded build_inspector importing her outline_check.
traces_to: outline 10.3.5 (CairnCommons/CairnComponentOutline.txt); Law 6 (one owner gates writes); RULE 1 (encapsulation); idea 2026-09-06-three-things-separate-paper-ownership-from-real (this is its location half); ticket 135a905eac3c (the same boundary measured from the inspector's side)
how: Six moves, one commit and reseal each, fewest outside callers first and build_inspector last. Each carries code, proofs, validations, probes, charter, history and state, and every caller is repointed in the same act. How callers outside her reach a moved component is open-a89d15043c7c. Decisions D1-D4.
falsifier: None of plan_inspector, diagnostic_inspector, corrosion, exemptions, rehearsal, build_inspector remains under cairn/machines/. Each one's charter sits at cairn/devices/codemother/machines/<name>/intention+why.json with owner codemother and its gated_by unchanged. Every moved proof reseals green at its new address. cairn/machines/build_inspector/proofs/test_encapsulation_holds.py (at its new address) and the commit reseal read green, with no RULE 1 red. Wrong intent if a moved component serves something other than the code pipeline, or if any caller reaches into her code by a path RULE 1 forbids.
watchme: none, because the falsifier is structural and already watched by physics: cairn/machines/build_inspector/proofs/test_encapsulation_holds.py reds any caller reaching into a device by a path RULE 1 forbids, and component_color reds a moved component whose seals did not follow it.

decisions.text: D1: ORDER, one move per commit with each resealed green before the next, fewest outside callers first: plan_inspector (none outside), exemptions (build_inspector only), rehearsal (build_inspector and codemother's outline_check), corrosion (build_inspector, exemptions, tester), diagnostic_inspector (tools/base/breadcrumb_log.py, tools/gate/gate.py), build_inspector last (transitions, validation, chain/grammar, import_sieve, tester/hollow, learning_block and codemother's chart machines; 266 references in all).
D3: OWNERSHIP FIELDS. Each moved charter's owner names codemother. Its gated_by stays exactly as it stands (CC co-listed, ruling 2026-09-06), so the move changes no one's standing at clearance.

D4: RECORDS. history.json and state.json move with their component through the state/history door (git mv keeps the bytes; history_integrity compares against HEAD at the new path after the commit), never by hand-editing. Instance-space under ~/.cairn is untouched; only class-space moves. Every moved proof reseals at its new address with bin/cairn test --seal.

SCOPE (CC's earlier D2 was an error, caught by the outline check): all nine on outline 10.3.5 move. The earlier determinism measurement was a grep proxy: cairn/tools/bus_client names determinism only in its docstring and never calls it, so determinism passes the purpose test. The outline routes determinism (19.11), import_sieve (19.15) and ticket_inspector (19.28) '-> CodeMother', and the outline outranks CC's reading of CLAUDE.md's tool clause. The three tools move to cairn/devices/codemother/tools/<name>/, the held-tool shape CLAUDE.md names; the six machines move to cairn/devices/codemother/machines/<name>/.
